Hi all — I dug into the issuance logs for deal BTL-2026-031. Summary of findings:

- Coupon BT L-ONBOARD-50K registered successfully in the promotions service at 09:02 UTC on 2026-05-02.
- The asynchronous credit_grant job was triggered but one of the ledger reconciliation writes failed with a unique constraint violation on transactions (duplicate_request_id). This caused the grant job to abort and mark the grant as 'failed-retryable'.
- Our retry worker tried twice and then paused the job because retries exceeded 3 in 30 minutes. The job remained in pending-retry state and the UI shows the coupon accepted but no committed credit balance.

Immediate remediation I performed:
- Replayed the failed reconciliation write after deduping the conflicting request_id (this attaches the grant to the correct ledger row).
- Manually reconciled the interim test charge (the one Samira referenced) by applying the granted tokens to the test generation call timestamp so it will show as covered by promo credits and not bill the card. This is a manual ledger adjustment and will be removed from the card billing run.

Next steps (automation planned):
- Add stronger idempotency checks to the grant job so duplicate_request_id conflicts will be handled without aborting.
- Increase retry window for promotions grants to 24 hours for high-latency backend writes.

Samira — I applied the credits back to your account at 2026-05-03T11:10:00-07:00. You should see the 50,000 token promo balance in the console. Please confirm and I’ll close the ticket.

—Dev
